<thought>We need the number of unique hydrogen environments in the compound. The tool `proton_nmr_spectra` can provide the 1H NMR spectrum for the target compound (the SMILES is pre‑defined for this task). By examining the distinct signals in the spectrum we can count the unique proton types. We'll call the tool and then count the signals.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
